opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on Expedia's Cars tab by pick-up location, optional drop-off location, dates, times and sort order.
steps: Open the Cars tab.
Click the Pick-up field, type the location and select the matching suggestion.
If the drop-off differs, set the drop-off location; otherwise leave 'Same as pick-up'.
Open the pick-up date picker, choose the start date, choose the end date, and click Done.
Select the pick-up time and the drop-off time.
Click Search.
Choose a sort order (for example Total Price) on the results page.

instances.values: Pick-up and drop-off JFK (New York). Dates Apr 3 to Apr 6, 2023. Times 9:00 am pick-up, 6:00 pm drop-off. Sort by Total Price. Interrupted by Underarmour browsing and resumed at 2179.4.
Pick-up San Francisco, CA. Dates Apr 2 to Apr 8, 2023. Search submitted; times and sort not recorded.

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search
opportunities.description: Search flights on Booking.com by origin, destination and departure date(s), optionally multi-city, then pick the fastest option and proceed through selection.
steps: Click the Flights tab.
Optionally switch the trip type to Multi-city.
Click the origin field, type the city and select the matching suggestion.
Click the destination field, type the city and select the matching suggestion.
Open the departure date picker, choose the date(s) and click Done.
Click Search.
Sort results by Fastest, open a flight, click Select, then click Next.

instances.values: Origin typed as 'banglore', destination 'goa', departure 29 March 2023. Sorted by Fastest.
Multi-city. Leg 1 New York to Tokyo, 13 May and 1 June 2023. Leg 2 Tokyo to New Delhi, 5 June 2023. Sorted by Fastest.

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by destination region, departure port, month and number of guests.
steps: Click the Sail To selector and choose a destination.
Click the Sail From selector and choose a departure port.
Click the Dates selector and choose the month.
Click Search Cruises.
If the party size differs, open Number of Guests, increase guests to the target count, and close the selector.

instances.values: Sail To Panama Canal, Sail From San Francisco, CA, month October 2024.
Sail To Caribbean, guests increased to 4. Interrupted by Kohl's browsing and resumed.

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Find airport parking on SpotHero by airport name, parking dates and sort order.
steps: Click the Airport tab.
Type the airport name or code in the airport search box.
Select the matching suggestion.
Set the parking start and end dates in the date fields.
Choose a sort option from the Featured dropdown (for example Shuttle Time).

instances.values: JFK. Dates Apr 18 to Apr 20, 2023. Sort by Shuttle Time.
Dallas Love Field (DAL). Dates and sort not recorded.

opportunities.name: MTA planned service-change lookup
opportunities.description: Look up planned work or service changes for a subway/bus route on the MTA site, optionally for a specific date.
steps: Click the Planned Work or Planned Service Changes link.
Type the route name in the Search Routes box.
Select the matching route in the list.
Optionally open the date picker, navigate months with Next Month, and choose a date.

instances.values: Planned Service Changes page, route 4, date 04/12/2023 advanced one month to May 3, 2023.
